questions.question: Which Python expression creates an empty set?
questions.explanation: set() creates an empty set. Empty braces create a dictionary.

questions.question: Which Python expression returns the length of a list named records?
questions.explanation: Python uses len() to obtain the number of items in a list.

questions.question: Which FastAPI decorator handles POST requests sent to /reports?
questions.explanation: app.post registers a handler for the POST method.

questions.question: In Django, which file commonly declares the URL patterns for an application?
questions.explanation: A URL configuration commonly lives in urls.py and exposes urlpatterns.

questions.question: Which pair correctly matches each framework to a common routing API?
questions.explanation: Django routes via URL patterns. FastAPI commonly declares routes with method decorators.

questions.question: What does enumerate(['red', 'blue'], start=1) produce when consumed into a list?
questions.explanation: enumerate pairs each item with a counter that begins at the given start value.

questions.question: A Django queryset should keep Product rows priced above 50. Which expression fits?
questions.explanation: filter with the gt lookup selects rows whose field is greater than the value.

questions.question: Which Django model field expresses a many-to-one relation to another model?
questions.explanation: A ForeignKey lets many source rows reference one target row.

questions.question: A FastAPI POST handler accepts an argument typed as a Pydantic model. Where do the model's values normally come from?

options.d: The path template regardless of its name

questions.explanation: FastAPI treats a Pydantic model parameter as a request body by default.

questions.question: Which FastAPI object can mark a missing record with status 404 inside a handler?

options.a: A returned plain dict with a status_code key

questions.explanation: Raising HTTPException tells FastAPI to send the specified HTTP error.

questions.question: Which two Python expressions construct tuples? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: A single-item tuple literal needs a comma. tuple() can also build a tuple from an iterable.

questions.question: What does sorted([3, 1, 2]) return?
questions.explanation: sorted builds a new list in ascending order by default.

questions.question: Which built-in exception does int('apple') normally raise?
questions.explanation: A string of the right type with an invalid integer value raises ValueError.

questions.question: What is the value of result after result = {'a': 1}.get('b', 0)?
questions.explanation: dict.get returns the supplied default when the key is absent.

questions.question: What does with open(path) as stream handle when the block exits?

options.a: Turning the path into a directory

questions.explanation: A file context manager closes the file on normal exit and when an exception leaves the block.

questions.question: Which operations can add an item to an existing Python list named queue? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: append adds one item and extend adds the items of an iterable.

questions.question: Which argument declares HTTP 201 as the normal success status of a FastAPI route?
questions.explanation: The route's status_code argument declares the success response status.
